Here’s the honest take on “Avoid template sameness — theme it to you” — written for people who want a link that works harder than a PDF.

The default path (Drive folders, Canva PDFs, unfinished Notion pages) makes you look busy — not hire-ready.

This guide is for design-minded students who want taste without clutter who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

Restraint reads as confidence. Empty space and hierarchy often look more expensive than extra widgets.

Do this next

  1. Screenshot your homepage and mark the first thing the eye hits
  2. Move proof higher; move biography lower if needed
  3. Publish the change even if it’s imperfect

Make uniqueness visible

Your uniqueness is already in your projects and judgment. The website’s job is to frame that judgment so a stranger trusts it quickly.

How a website helps you stand out

Restraint reads as confidence. Empty space and hierarchy often look more expensive than extra widgets.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.com, create on dash.mybexo.com, share on yourname.atbexo.com. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • One accent color, not five
  • Let project images breathe
  • Motion only where it clarifies

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
